ramp: year-1 output vs full (first crop establishment; Dutch practice for new houses)
dev_frac: design, planning, legal, site investigation (feasibility-stage allowance)
import_conn_gbp: 11 kV connection near a substation GBP 50-150k (solargridcheck.co.uk G99 guide 2026, DNO averages); upper end
overheads_m2: management, office, certification, accounts (no UK source found)
land_gbp_ha: land rent near an industrial host; Scottish arable rent is ~GBP 250-500/ha, industrial land more
plants_m2: UK greenhouse tomato plant material GBP 1.61-2.01/m2 (Life cycle cost analysis of tomato production in innovative urban agriculture systems, J. Cleaner Production 2022); KWIN 2023: tomato seedling EUR 3.00/plant (grafted, ~2.5 plants/m2 -> ~GBP 6.4/m2); central between. Cucumber: three crops/yr of cheaper plants (estimate)
materials_m2: UK greenhouse tomato other materials GBP 2.27-2.48/m2 (J. Cleaner Production 2022, as above): fertiliser, crop protection, pollination, strings, water; cucumber without bumblebees (estimate)
